# HexPiece 2.8.2

- **Fighting styles in first person:** every Black Leg, Six Powers, Fishman Karate and Iron Fist move now shows your arms in first
  person (they were hidden before), and so do the Light and Dragon fruits' moves.
- **Your legs in first person:** a kick now shows your leg, in your own skin and trousers, attached to your body where third person
  has it. You see it rise into view as you kick, and looking down shows the whole kick.
- **Mutton Shot and Sky Walk:** the leg no longer goes up through your face. It rises well in front of you, then comes down.
- Nothing here has been tested in game yet. The build's checks pass, and the kicks were rendered and checked off-game.
